name: Undead
description: This creature has no resolve and cannot be affected by resolve-targeting effects. It does not need to breathe, eat, or sleep.

name: Compliant
description: This undead can follow complex commands and perform non-combat tasks without requiring the Command Undead action.

name: Brittle Bones
description: Skeletons cannot mitigate physical damage from blunt weapons.

name: Undying
description: When this creature reaches 0 health, roll a 1d4. On a 2 or higher, it regains 20 health. This trait does not activate if the killing blow dealt divine or dark damage.
